sections.skill: Read margins of error in poll reports

branch.new_demand: Use margins of error to judge claims in poll reports.
branch.builds_on: Builds on FORWARD 1: knowing what controls the margin of error, the student judges reports that use one.

questions.domain: Statistics & Probability: Making Inferences & Justifying Conclusions
questions.skill: Read margins of error in poll reports

questions.prompt: Candidate A has 48% and candidate B has 45%, each with a margin of error of 4 percentage points. What is the best conclusion?
questions.prompt_markup: Candidate A has 48% and candidate B has 45%, each with a margin of error of 4 percentage points. What is the best conclusion?

choices.text: Both candidates have under 50%, so both lose.
Too close to call: the two intervals overlap a lot.
B is certainly behind A by at least 3 points.
A is certainly ahead of B by exactly 3 points.

questions.correct_answer: Too close to call: the two intervals overlap a lot.
